headline: Marcella Kozinski Returns To Miss Universe 2026 Activities In PR
metaDescription: Miss Brazil Marcella Kozinski has resumed her schedule for the 75th Miss Universe in Puerto Rico after previously withdrawing due to a viral illness.
aiSummaryBullets: Marcella Kozinski has returned to her official duties at the 75th Miss Universe competition after a brief period of absence.
The Brazilian representative had previously withdrawn from scheduled activities earlier in the week due to a viral illness.
The Miss Universe pageant is currently being held in Puerto Rico, with the final competition scheduled for November 24, 2026.
aiContextParagraph: The 75th edition of the Miss Universe pageant is currently taking place in Puerto Rico, featuring 116 contestants from around the globe. Marcella Kozinski, the 26-year-old representative from Brazil, is participating in the competition as the country seeks its third title in the pageant's history, a feat not achieved in 58 years. Earlier in the week, reports confirmed that Kozinski temporarily withdrew from her scheduled appearances after falling ill with a viral condition. She has since recovered and resumed her participation in the lead-up to the grand finale. The event, which has included diverse representation among candidates, is set to culminate in a crowning ceremony on November 24, 2026. Organizers have highlighted that the winner will be presented with a new crown featuring over 3,000 diamonds.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two major outlets monitoring the competition's progress and the status of the Brazilian contestant.
